title: Posture
description: A carrier's posture: an intent to provide (spec §7.1), item S3. Per kind, the terms it offers, at the reach the posture is visible. Written when it changes, with hysteresis, never on a timer; its liveness is read by the observer from presence or inventory freshness, never assumed from the posture (D3). Self is a candidate only through its own posture as it arrived from the same shared source every peer reads (guarded self-candidacy, R4, spec §7.2). Built on the device by DeviceFacts::posture, the device facts' only way off the device. Wire shape: this schema is the source of record; placement_core::Posture and OfferTerms (elohim/placement/core/src/offer.rs; serde camelCase, deny_unknown_fields on the posture) are its Rust mirror, not yet pinned to it by a test (follow-on: a placement-core schema_contract case that validates a serialized Posture here). Source of truth: the carrier's own posture record. Category A at or above public reach as a record every peer reads; below public a household-local record (R2); no new DHT entry type. The custody instance today is elohim-storage's salvage_capacity rows.

carrier.description: The carrier. An agent key (`uhCAk…`), the canonical agent identity (elohim_epr_rea::model::AgentRef / AgentRefKey, a string newtype). Never a transport id and never a CID.

additionalProperties.title: OfferTerms
additionalProperties.description: What a carrier offers for one kind. Device facts never appear here: battery, metered link and budget cross only as their effect, a narrowed, deferred or withdrawn offer (R6, rail R-P4).

spareBytes.description: Bytes offered; null when the kind spends none. A u64 in Rust, bounded here to 9007199254740991 (2^53 - 1, the largest integer every JSON reader, JavaScript included, holds exactly); a larger value is refused, never rounded.

compute.description: Compute offered; null when the kind spends none.

holds.description: Roots kept at depth 3, each listed only when its own reach is no narrower than the posture's (F8): a posture never names a root below its own reach.

reachCeiling.description: The widest reach the carrier will carry for; null sets no ceiling.

scopes.description: What a task offer will spend (F6).

isolation.description: The isolation the offer provides (F6); null when the kind runs no process.

deferred.description: Held only in a charging or unmetered window (D11): eligible, charged as a lag, never as an ineligibility.

householdOnly.description: Offered to its own household's needs only. A phone on battery keeps its own-household custody offer, household-only and deferred, so a two-phone household with no hub still holds its own bytes.

offers.description: Per kind, what is offered. A kind not listed is not offered.

reach.description: How far the posture is visible.

writtenAt.description: When the carrier wrote it, seconds since the Unix epoch. A u64 in Rust, bounded here to 9007199254740991 (2^53 - 1, the largest integer every JSON reader, JavaScript included, holds exactly); a larger value is refused, never rounded.
